title: Uka Arupax Jan ch’amanchatawa
intro: Aka jaqix wali yatiñaniwa ukat irpatawa, walja maranakat sipan juk’amp iwxt’awinak churaraki. Arunakapax Diosar yupaychañ uñacht’ayi ukat Divino ukan bendicionanakap yant’äwinakap uñt’añax wali wakiskiriwa. Uka jach’añchat almax khitïpachas uk uñt’ayañamawa.
clues: Janiw nayajj profetäkti, ukampis yatiñajajj Divina Qellqatanakan jan jiwirjamawa.
Wawajar iwxt’atajax Allah-ar yuspärañ tuqitwa ukat shirk-at jithiqtañatakiwa.
Diosar mayisiñajj kunja wakiskirisa, askinak mayisiña ukat jan walinak jarkʼañaw kunja wakiskirisa uka toqet yatichayäta.
Jachʼa jachʼa tukuñata ukat aka oraqen jan jachʼa jachʼa tukuñamp sarnaqañat ewjjtʼayäta.
Nayan sutijax Quran ukan mä taqpach jaljaruw uñt’ayasi, yatichäwinakaj uñacht’ayasa.
Nayan ewjjtʼajajj jan waltʼäwinakan paciencianïñawa, cheqas ukajj jukʼamp chʼamachasiñat juti.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
